title: Video | Delimitation Talks | Centre- Meta Row | Jharkhand Protest | Assam Floods | Monsoon session - NDTV
article_text: Major political, policy and public issues continue to dominate the headlines. The Centre has reportedly intensified outreach to Opposition parties amid fresh buzz over the Delimitation Bill's possible return to Parliament. Meta remains under government scrutiny following discussions with the Centre, while the JPSC-JSSC student agitation in Jharkhand has entered its 12th day, prompting talks between protesters and the Hemant Soren government. The issue has also triggered a political face-off between the BJP and Rahul Gandhi-led Congress. Meanwhile, the judicial panel report on the Sambhal violence has sparked fresh political controversy, and Assam continues to battle a worsening flood crisis, with rising casualties and thousands affected.
